notes: firstRelease is the earliest published tag containing evidenceCommit, checked with `git tag --contains`. Compare kinds: eq = frozen value, gte = monotonic integer, members = string list membership, object = fixed-shape object.

capabilities.name: session_queue
capabilities.missing: Do not take over backend queues; existing queues keep their owner.

capabilities.name: computer_session_approval
capabilities.missing: Hide session-wide approval; confirm each computer action.

capabilities.name: memory_switch
capabilities.missing: Do not send the memory switch field; keep the saved value.

capabilities.name: image_model_toggle
capabilities.missing: Do not send model-level image toggles; keep legacy probing.

capabilities.name: session_exists
capabilities.missing: Use the existing migration check; never treat unknown as absent.

capabilities.name: session_changes
capabilities.missing: Disable incremental sync and fall back to full refresh.

capabilities.name: ai_review_per_run
capabilities.missing: Do not send review_scope; keep the global AI approval setting visible (it applies to every permission mode and auto review needs a configured reviewer model).

capabilities.name: permission_rules
capabilities.missing: Ignore permission.requested suggestion; offer only allow once (and the computer session grant), send allow_always without scope, hide the permission rules settings and ignore permission.auto_resolved.

capabilities.name: readonly_auto_allow
capabilities.missing: Expect read-only tools and commands to prompt in normal mode; set an explicit allow policy to skip those prompts.

capabilities.name: permission_modes
capabilities.missing: Block a send whose saved mode is unsupported; let the user pick per-call confirmation.

capabilities.name: image
capabilities.missing: Disable image UI; supported may change at runtime and bumps capabilityRevision.

capabilities.name: run_sandbox
capabilities.missing: Disable sandbox modes and never send options.sandbox; the backend would ignore it and run commands unconfined.
